SOURCE-ASSISTED SELECTED READING (recheck, 11 October 2026)

Base: batch-2026-10-11-image-only. The reader knew the earlier ledger entry (Decretals X 3.5.6 as source locus) before reading, read the image directly, then compared with the printed casus. Parentheses expand abbreviations; square brackets mark text lost or supplied; a question mark follows an uncertain reading. Native-pixel boxes are x0,y0,x1,y1.

Face A: manifest canvas labelled fol. [1]r (image file fol_1v.jp2, 3013 x 3369), main column, box 400,520,1330,1260.
A1: [..]or(um) corrigatur p(er) ep(iscop)os in quor(um)
A2: [iuris]dic(ti)o(n)e? cl(er)ici (con)sistunt (et) de b(e)n(e)ficiis
A3: istor(um) que optinent c(ontra) canones
A4: (et) p(er)ic(u)l(u)m a(n)i(m)ar(um) inducunt p(ro)vide-
A5: atur paup(er)ib(us) cl(er)icis qui eccl(es)iis va-
A6: leant deservire. [red paragraph] No(ta) q(uod) nemo
A7: pot(est) h(abe)re duas eccl(es)ias sine p(er)ic(u)lo
A8: anime n(isi) dispensative p(er) p(a)p(a)m.
A9: [large red C] Um teneamur. Aliquis h(abe)ns
A10: sufficiens b(e)n(e)ficiu(m) impetra-
A11: vit l(itte)ras p(ro) alio b(e)n(e)ficio in alia ec-
A12: cl(es)ia optinendo. nec fecit m(en)c(i)o(n)em
A13: de b(e)n(e)ficio q(uod) h(abe)bat. q(ue)situm fuit
A14: a p(a)p(a). utr(um) teneretur ille cui l(itte)re diri-
A15: guntur p(ro)vid(er)e illi auct(oritat)e illar(um) lit-
A16: terar(um). R(espondet) p(a)p(a). si ma(n)datu(m) [nostrum ...]
A2 is the least secure line: the word before "clerici consistunt" is damaged.

Face B: manifest canvas labelled fol. [1]v (image file fol_1r.jp2, 3063 x 3091), main column, box 740,400,1680,1130. The upper lines are rubbed; only the following are offered.
B2: [suspen]sionis (et) ex(com)m(unication)is ut ad obedientiam ep(iscop)i
B3: sui [archi]ep(iscop)i? redeant. (et) si eor(um) mali-
B4: cia [sic] (com)pesci n(on) pot(er)it cardi-
B5: nalis ap(osto)lice se(dis) legatus remove-
B6: at eos ab adm(in)istrac(i)o(n)e suar(um) ec-
B7: cl(es)iar(um) (et) eccl(es)iis ill(is) de p(er)sonis ido-
B8: neis faciat p(ro)videri. S(ed) eos n(on)
B9: deponat ut cu(m) eis si expedi(er)it
B10: mis(er)icordit(er) agi possit. [No(ta) quod]
B11: q(ui) n(on) (com)paret ap(ud) domiciliu(m) [suum ...]
B13: [...] expectatur p(er) vi
B14: me(n)ses. It(em) ar(gumentum) q(uod) cu(m) deposito n(on) fit
B15: [rubric and decorated initial; rubric not read]
B16: [...] Quida(m) cl(er)ici obti[nuerunt ...]
B3, B11 and B13 are partial. The rubric in B15 was not read and is not used.

Left unread: the slivers of the adjacent columns on both faces, and the marginal notes. This is a model reading made with the printed text to hand, not a human palaeographic transcription.
